answer: A payout is split which means 29% arrives at settlement and the rest over 17 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The karst schedule is applied in harbor and mirror exposes each instalment. An hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3552 identities would post 1192 proofs and burn roughly 45 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
